The '''Dantooine system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and the [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Dina/Legends|Dina]].

The [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] period of this [[Star system/Legends|system's]] outermost planet lasted more than 2,000 [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]]. The system was also found to contain the unusual [[acid asteroid]]s.

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], rumors of an [[Dantooine base/Legends|abandoned Rebel base]] has attracted many travelers and organizations on Dantooine. Consequently, the traffic increased significantly in the system.<ref name="SWG website">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66853&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Dantooine System}}</ref>
